cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Identify the three service classes offered by the Data Link Layer
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires naming all three classes: unconfirmed connectionless, confirmed connectionless, and connection-oriented

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Describe the distinguishing properties of unconfirmed connectionless service
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires identifying the lack of ACK, potential data loss, and absence of flow/connection control
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Explaining distinguishing properties of each class (1.5 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: unconfirmed connectionless - no ACK, loss of data possible, no flow control, no connect or disconnect.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Describe the distinguishing properties of confirmed connectionless service
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires identifying the use of ACK, potential for duplicates/sequence errors, and absence of flow/connection control
acceptable_variants: no data loss but potential duplicates
no flow control or connection management
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Explaining distinguishing properties of each class (1.5 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: confirmed connectionless - with ACK, no loss of data... duplicates and sequence errors possible, no flow control, no connect or disconnect.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Describe the distinguishing properties of connection-oriented service
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires identifying reliable delivery and the use of connection/flow control
evidence_facets: 3 phased communication with connect and disconnect
acceptable_variants: no errors in sequence or duplicates
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Explaining distinguishing properties of each class (1.5 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: connection-oriented - no data loss, duplication or sequencing errors. Instead a 3 phased communication with connect and disconnect, and flow control
